prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a premium photorealistic studio product photograph, square format. Three unbranded paperback study books standing upright on a warm ivory seamless surface and background, softly lit from upper left, subtle believable contact shadows. All three book FRONT COVERS must be perfectly flat rectangles parallel to the image plane with horizontal top/bottom edges and vertical sides, camera exactly frontal, no perspective skew. Large main A4 proportion book in center foreground, two slightly smaller books behind on left and right, arranged symmetrically, enough of both rear covers visible for titles. Thin ivory page edges visible at top; realistic dark forest green spines. All covers entirely blank solid dark forest green, no text, no logos, no symbols, no emblems, no artwork. The covers will be replaced deterministically with real artwork later. Main book occupies about x=33%-68%, y=15%-86%, rear books x=10%-40% and 62%-91%, y=27%-80%. Generous margins, polished physical paper texture, elegant catalog photography, no props, no rounded cover corners, no watermark.

Generous margins, fine matte paper texture, elegant catalog photography matching a book pack shoot, no props, no watermark.
